answer: Cheap extra names fail when each agent must lease one exclusive karst alcove and keep a copper trellis that only a tagged census raven will alight on. An applicant locks 43 coins for 19 days on alcove K-11 and rivets a one-use trellis whose serial is etched at intake. At first light a clerk photographs the raven band against the official sinkhole staff and files the still with that serial. Peers attest only if the karst cadastre lists the serial once and the band code matches intake. A borrowed trellis or two names on one alcove burns the lock and returns K-11 to auction.
